text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, a ball 
suddenly came flying from somewhere—
Excuse me~~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I threw it with all my strength and it 
slipped right out of my hand... Are you 
hurt anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No... actually, I was just playing with 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing so many different events at 
the U.A.F. made me curious about what 
other sports are out there♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I know! If you'd like, why don't you 
join in too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, could it be a new member? 
Welcoooome!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ More coming right up★ Bring 'em 
on!!
choice_data_list: Excuse me. What were you doing?
Excuse me. What were you up to?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, well, up until just now we were 
playing dodgeball, and kickball, and—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We played lacrosse and boccia too☆ It was 
thrilling, suspenseful, and sooooo 
marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There really are so many different kinds 
of sports! There are tons of ball games 
I've never even heard of.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm doing this, I've been looking up 
the rules for ball games I didn't know—and 
challenging myself to conquer every single 
one♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, and then? What are we doing 
next?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's have our marvelous guest decide! 
Trainer, which one do you want to play 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
First up is "Umamusume Tennis," where you 
can play 2v2 matches—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Or, kicking this ball back and forth, 'C 
O S M I C C R E A T I O N'!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"The Planet Ball might just change the 
laws of the universe! ☆! ★? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Which one do you prefer? I'm sure both 
will be fun♪
choice_data_list:
I might be interested if it's "Umamusume 
Tennis."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
'Uma Musume Tennis', I copy! Then, Maya 
and the others will show you how it's 
done♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Here I go, Mave-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahaâ Not done yeeeeet!!
(Whap-whap-whap, whap-whap-whaaam!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll show you an even cooler 
side of me! —Mayachin, taking off♪
(BA-BOOOM!)

Mayano Top Gun's smash, leaping higher 
than the second floor to unleash it, was 
tremendous...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, as expected of both of them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well Trainer-san, shall we go join in 
right away?♪
choice_data_list:
C-Could you let me watch for a bit 
longer!?

text_block_list.text:
Faced with such high-intensity play, I 
just couldn't muster the courage to join 
in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine if you don't understand. Truth 
is, this is a brand-new ball game we came 
up with♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Pairs of two kick the ball back and forth, 
keeping it higher and higher—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You know, just imagine it, Trainer! If you 
kick the planet ball high, high, hiiiiigh 
up, it gets closer and closer to the 
sky—to outer space, right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That means someday, we can deliver a new 
star to the sky with our own power!! Isn't 
that just super marvelous☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, it'd definitely be faster to just 
try it than talk about it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know, we've gotten to the point where 
we can kick it all the way up to the 
school rooftop! Today, we're aiming for 
the clouds above--!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano and Others
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

Together with the three enthusiastic 
girls, I focused on kicking the ball 
around for a while.
